sn22.151:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati. kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.3: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassatīti.
sn22.151:1.5: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati. rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati. vedanāya sati …pe… saññāya sati …pe… saṅkhāresu sati …pe…
sn22.151:1.6: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.7: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati.
